DARV.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.0-: Your place here…… is quite noisy. But you have many things. While I wait, I'll take a look around.
Of course! In this dull wait, feel free to pick any forgotten gem!
DARV.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.1-: Still waiting? Take your time — I'm in no rush with that pile. If you can afford to wait, so can I!
DARV.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.2-: I've countless gems here, but the one you're waiting for…… doesn't seem to be among them.

If you truly had the one I seek…… it needn't glitter. It only needs to appear when the time is right.
[i][font_size=22]Godo simply stands there, like a nail blunted by time.[/font_size][/i]
……Very well. Save your choice for next time. You seem accustomed to making "next time" wait quite long.
NEOW.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.0-: You've pulled me from the silence again…… Where shall I go wait this time?
NEOW.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.2-: If you would grant me something…… grant me the strength to "wait one more time." I lack nothing else.

[sine]...Go now... 
..I will... be where... you turn back... ..still there.....[/sine]
NONUPEIPE.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYA: A splendid room. A dazzling you. But I…… am just an old coat that hasn't been picked up yet.
Oh my, even an old coat can shine brilliantly after receiving my blessing.
Are you waiting for a late victory? Come, let me dress you up to look more like a winner.
Even if you mean to tie yourself to a moment that will never come, you shouldn't look so disheveled.
……I don't need to look good. I only need "it's not over yet."
You have no sense of style. Take it. Let me watch you keep waiting — wearing my light, and your patience.
You're dancing. I'm waiting. Which of us is crazier?
Neither's crazy!! Neither!! Try this to pass the time!!
Don't rush, don't rush! You mustn't rush! Waiting is…… is…… a very long lightning bolt!!
Giving you something!! What do you want? A sound that "will ring again tomorrow"!?
……I've put silence in my pocket. Want to feel it?
Good! Good! Then it's settled: I'll keep being noisy, and you keep waiting!!
PAEL.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.0-: Your snoring is like the tide…… In the tidal waters I wait — I won't drown, only grow quieter.
[thinky_dots]Quiet traveler…… take a piece of me, seek peace within the tidal waters……[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.1-: [thinky_dots]The awake always want to hurry on, only those who sleep understand staying still…… Rest a while too……[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.2-: [thinky_dots]Take my flesh and blood…… a bit of flesh that "won't rush you"……[/thinky_dots]
……I'm not afraid of pain. Only afraid that pain will drag me away from the waiting.
[thinky_dots]Take it…… let you keep lying here…… waiting for that road that hasn't come……[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.0-: You want to fight. I want to wait. Can we…… each do our own thing?
[b]No!! Take this weapon! Go get stronger!!![/b]
TANX.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.1-: [b]Your blood has long gone cold! But combat can make even patience boil!![/b]
TANX.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.2-: [b]Stop waiting for that person! Fight me — this is your destiny now!![/b]

If we must fight…… wait until that person comes. He will strike back in my stead.
[i][font_size=22]Godo takes half a step back, as if yielding the battlefield to the future.[/font_size][/i]
[b]Cowardly!! But your patience is limitless!! Take this weapon and go wait![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYA: The fire is warm. But what I'm waiting for isn't warmth — it's "the appointed time."
It's okay even if the time hasn't come yet. Come in, let me [jitter][b]warm[/b][/jitter] you up while you wait.
Is the only luggage you carry that bit of [jitter][b]hesitation[/b][/jitter]? Shall I burn it away for you?
Dear, try this [jitter][b]treat[/b][/jitter] I made for you. It's the kind that needs to cool slowly, and to be waited for slowly.
……I'm not hungry. I'm just empty. Emptiness and hunger look alike.
Fine, just a taste then. And then we'll keep waiting — until the bitterness [jitter][b]fades away[/b][/jitter].
VAKUU.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.0: Demons also make deals. So what of mine do you want? My time? It was never worth much.
Worthless [sine]time[/sine], when accumulated, can be quite substantial……
VAKUU.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.1: I usually sell "right now" at a steep price. But facing you, I'm tempted to put a high price even on [sine]"someday"[/sine].
VAKUU.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.2: If I wrote a line in fine print at the bottom of the contract: permitting you to [sine]wait forever[/sine] — would you sign?
……My name doesn't matter. What matters is that I haven't been called yet.
Take your price. I will never wake you — unless [sine]that moment[/sine] truly arrives.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_: You stand here, yet it seems you are nowhere. What are you waiting for? The top of the tower? An ending? Or a single word of permission?
Answer
……I'm waiting for a name to be spoken. Until it is, I'm not going anywhere.
Continue
Permission? You never needed it. You're just afraid of "waiting for the wrong thing."
You return again. Time for you is like a corridor — you can't walk to its end, because you don't want to.
Continue
The corridor is good. The end is not. The end means…… there's nothing left to wait for.
Continue
Foolish. If you don't walk toward the end, you'll forever be nothing but an echo.
Then stand. The tower will remember for you: that you came, many times, and took nothing away.
Continue
If I take something away…… will it make me stop waiting?
Continue
It will. So don't take anything. Keep waiting — it's the only weapon you're good at.
